correctness.rationale: Merged symbols reproduce every base-m digit of y. For star indicator s_n the product is ergodic and the weighted Birkhoff average N^-1 sum exp(-2pi i n alpha)s_n converges to exp(2pi i theta)*hat(h)(1)/m; for h(t)=t, hat(h)(1)=i/(2pi). A generator on only m atoms would have entropy rate log m and hence every block independent uniform; its Bernoulli name factor is mixing, contradictory to the nontrivial irrational-rotation Koopman eigenfunction. The proof handles all irrational alpha and m>=2 modulo Haar-null coding boundaries, not topological pointwise generation.
